integrity: The code is reconstructed from the public generator matrix. Exact finite enumeration checks the LCD property, all codewords, all projective lines and hyperplanes, and the complete projective stabilizer.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the displayed ternary \([23,4,14]\) representative only. The projective fingerprint is not claimed to classify all inequivalent optimal codes with these parameters.
title: Projective fingerprint of the optimal ternary \([23,4,14]\) LCD code
